newsitem.title: USA: Sykes to acquire Info Systems of N.C..
newsitem.headline: Sykes to acquire Info Systems of N.C..

text.p: Sykes Enterprises Inc said Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Info Systems of N.C. Inc for about $23 million in common stock.
Under the deal, which Sykes said it saw becoming accretive, Info Systems of N.C. Inc. will operate as a wholly owned subsidiary, it said.
Sykes, a provider of computer-related outsourcing services to Fortune 500 firms, said it would report the acquisition as a pooling of interests.
Info Systems designs, programs, licenses and supports software solutions for the manufacturing, distribution and retail industries, earnings revenues of about $32 million.
